answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a timber bet on surviving 43 epochs of grading, and every pulse settlement recomputes the umber schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 43 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
